_comment: Every lookup table the Website Intake Runtime uses. Edit these to retune classification/qualification — no code change needed. See ../../website-intake-model.md for the reasoning behind each table.

sourcePageClassification._note: The website page a visitor was on when they clicked through to the contact form — the strongest single signal, checked before any keyword match. 'contact' and 'start-a-conversation' carry no page-specific signal, so they fall through to keyword matching.

classificationKeywords._note: Checked in this order (first match wins) when sourcePage doesn't already determine a classification.

sourceCategoryByClassification._note: opportunity-schema.json's sourceCategory enum is Marketplace/Professional Network/Recruiter Channel/Consulting Channel/Compliance Programme/Technology Practice/Direct/Referral. Every website lead is Direct/Referral except Partnership, which is Consulting Channel (matches ingest.py's classify() Consulting Channel + high strategicValue -> Partnership rule).

industryKeywords._note: Best-effort inference from the submitted message/organisation only — 'Not specified' when nothing matches, never guessed beyond what the text actually says.

geographyKeywords._note: Same served-geography vocabulary opportunity-hunter/runtime/collectors/common.py already uses, reused for consistency.

discoveryCallAgendaByClassification._note: A real, structured discovery-call agenda per Lead Classification — the opening/closing structure every AI for U&I discovery call already follows (context, scope, next steps); the middle section's questions reuse sales-director/runtime/prepare.py's own clarifying_questions() logic pattern, not a second invented question set.
default: Introductions and context: what prompted reaching out now
Understand the current state: what exists today, who owns it, what's changed recently
Clarify scope: fixed engagement, ongoing advisory, or still exploratory
Discuss timeline and any deadline driving urgency
Outline AI for U&I's relevant experience and approach
Agree next steps and who owns each one

High: Offer discovery call times within 48 hours
Flag to CEO Advisor as same-day priority
Medium: Offer discovery call times within the week

qualificationDefaults._note: Documented, adjustable defaults for the 0-10 dimensions a raw enquiry gives no direct signal for — the same kind of labelled default used throughout AOS (rate-card.json, revenue-hunter's CRM-sourced defaults). A self-initiated website enquiry is treated as moderately higher relationship/probability than a cold scraped posting, since the visitor reached out first.
